claims.title: Marine storage: mineral pores, pressure-matched gas, thermal and service limits

quoted_fields.interface: Complete grid-side 1 MW continuous 100 h/100 MWh after isolated 144 h hold; charge <=100 h and <=2 MW total import; >=65% complete AC efficiency including auxiliaries, leakage, gas handling, cooling, restart and restored inventories. Real deep-water access, pressure structure, foundations, installation, machinery, grid, service and removal paid. Targets <=15 USD/useful delivered kWh installed and <=125 USD/MWh at 20 USD/MWh charging, with 40 USD and lower-use cases; 344 h schedule, 90% availability, 20 yr and 8% real finance. Separately evaluate 100 kW/10 MWh, first installation and decisive prototype. Hypotheses are not qualified hardware or surveyed sites.
quoted_fields.failure: The whole economical marine invention remains unresolved. Approximately 65% modeled efficiency has little margin and depends on unmeasured hysteresis/gas assumptions. Actual conditioned porosity/permeability/creep, full-pressure moving support/seams/ports, foundation parcel and route, pump/turbine simultaneous curves, subsea reliability, startup transient, barrier life and renewal productivity are not supplied. Friction-only gas accounting is a valid sensitivity rather than proof that central extra gas-column work is unavoidable. Financial horizon is not every component life. Source-reported prototype/literature/supplier scopes do not establish this store; opaque citation identities are not guessed or recovered. Separate pressure fragment and rendered continuation limits remain explicit. All known/unknown access/transfer holds persist; no source, artifact, Library or archive recovery, model replay, procurement or physical experiment. ROOT distinct Ren2024 shallow-bag observation and Wieberdink2018/Ren2019 chamber experiments do not establish deep-field life, whole-path AC efficiency, pressure-matched power train or complete price. No held identity was recovered or released; no SI/cited-original/thesis/provider download was followed. A pressure-matched mean does not remove vertical gradients, buoyancy, membrane tension or service.
